customConcept.name: Anomalous fine dining
customConcept.blurb: Fine dining for the anomalous community, from Chaz Ambrose: cockatrice, kraken-egg caviar and a stew that has been cooking for two thousand years, in rooms the ordinary world walks straight past.

state.circumstances: You are Chaz Ambrose. You started cooking to pay your way around the world, and now your name is on restaurants in London, Backdoor SoHo and Three Portlands, with a room of doors behind every kitchen. Marius keeps the books. The food is extraordinary, the guests are not all strictly people, and none of it is illegal, exactly. A year ago the Foundation's One Star Reviewers walked into the Temecula restaurant for lunch, and they have been working their way down the list ever since.

setting.name: The heart of London, a short walk from the station
setting.desc: A dining room in central London that most people walk straight past. The guests are collectors sent by Marshall, Carter and Dark's sales people, visitors over from Three Portlands by way of the Isle of Portland, readers of London Underworld, and the occasional person who has no idea what they have booked.

ev.text: A council environmental health officer asked to see the walk-in. It was somewhere else until she left, and she has made a note to come back.
London Underworld ran another five-star notice, praising the service, the Kraken egg and the live dragon.
The reviewer from The Holy Grail has written again about waking up in Marrakesh, and about his lawsuit.

desk.title: A table for four who don't know where they are
desk.text: Four people from an ordinary office have turned up with a booking made through an ordinary website. Nobody knows how. They are delighted with the room and have asked whether the dragon is a puppet.

choices.label: Serve them the whole menu
choices.blurb: Four happy guests, and four people who saw a cockatrice.

choices.label: Tell them it's a themed evening and send out the Volcano Cake
choices.blurb: A shorter dinner and a story they'll tell as a joke.

choices.label: Lose the booking, comp a drink and walk them to the door

world.notes:
This save is set in the universe of the SCP Wiki (scp-wiki.wikidot.com), behind the Veil that hides the anomalous from the ordinary world. Ambrose Restaurants is a chain of fine-dining restaurants serving anomalous food to all parts of the anomalous community. Its ethos is "a remarkable culinary experience for a very reasonable price", and its founder's line is that Ambrose should be "a safe harbour for you to enjoy the unusual delights of the universe without the horror". It is believed to be jointly owned by Chaz Ambrose, the founder (a baseline human with minor anomalous properties, who cooks with thaumaturgy he picked up travelling with anartists as a teenager), and Marius (no surname known), who runs the business side: short, broad, even-toned and unreadable. Chaz writes the staff newsletter "Chaz's Corner", which opens "Dear Valued Ambrose Restaurant Family Members,". Andrew is Head of Marketing; Chaz doesn't know his surname.

THE PURSUIT. The SCP Foundation files Ambrose as Group of Interest GoI-116: status active, threat level Yellow (non-hostile, normalcy threatening). Mobile Task Force Lambda-14 ("One Star Reviewers") specialises in retail-oriented locations and anomalies, from single restaurants to whole shopping districts, and has concentrated on Ambrose since its first investigation of one. It is based at Site-34 in Southern California under Site Director Dumas, and has two containment teams, fifty mobile agents, ten thaumaturgy specialists and twenty anomalous art specialists. Its rules of engagement: Ambrose people are non-hostile and will typically flee; approach with caution and do not engage in combat unless instigated. Its orders: shut down any new location and save the information. That first investigation was the Temecula, California restaurant, on a lunchtime detail: Agent Nathan Ryans was killed by his meal, Agent Richard Price died in the kitchen, Agent Kiaran Stewart was lost beyond one of its doors, and Specialist Rhianne Watson, a thaumaturgy expert, got out alone and broke the door's frame behind her. The Foundation kept the Temecula menu. The Foundation's file lists known bases of operations at Portlands, Backdoor Soho and London, which are the three restaurants in this save. The Global Occult Coalition is also keen to see Ambrose out of business.

HOW IT WORKS. Behind each kitchen is a back room of identical doors: Ways to other kitchens, markets and realities. Ingredients, staff and some guests arrive through them. Suppliers and partners named on the wiki: Herman Fuller's Circus of the Disquieting (Midnight Cotton Candy, and a kraken-egg caviar route), Marshall, Carter and Dark (partners in the Backdoor SoHo gallery), Darrel, who runs a marina and supplies the Soul Striders for the Seance Soup, the parabotanist Stella Lindholm, and the daemons of Levania on the Moon. The chain says it does not have to comply with food safety regulations set by any government. Three Portlands is an independent city-state in a pocket universe, reached by Way from Portland, Maine, Portland, Oregon and the Isle of Portland; about 80,000 people live there, it uses dollars and sterling, and the Hoover Mandate of the FBI's Unusual Incidents Unit prohibits Foundation action in the city.

THE BACK ROOM IN THIS SAVE is not a crime. Nothing Ambrose does is against a law anyone could read out in a court; the trouble is that the Foundation exists to keep the public from finding out that any of it is possible. Play the forces accordingly. Lambda-14 doesn't take anyone to court: it shuts the restaurant, carries off what's in the kitchen to be numbered and studied, detains whoever didn't reach a door in time, gives the neighbours amnestics and writes a report. Health inspectors, accountants and food critics from the ordinary world are a danger because of what they might see, not because of what they might charge. "Dirty cash" in this save is takings in currencies no ordinary bank will accept, and washing it means running it through the till as ordinary sales. The tone is light without being nonsense: these are, at the end of the day, restaurants, and they should always be somewhere a guest would want to sit down and enjoy a nice meal. Focus on the people and the food. Staff who are cornered run for a door.

WHAT COMES FROM THE WIKI AND WHAT DOESN'T. From the wiki: everything above, the logo, the three menus and their prices. London's menu is the Ambrose London four-course prix fixe at 700 GBP, or 850 GBP with the wine selection; on the wiki a guest chooses one dish per course, and here it runs as a tasting menu at that price. Backdoor SoHo's is its December 2014 grand-opening menu, a $249 ticket that included a tour of the Marshall, Carter & Dark gallery and a live act. The Three Portlands food is the Temecula menu with its dollar prices, and the four drinks are the Three Portlands soda bar's (April 2015), with theirs. Estimated or invented for this save: that Three Portlands serves the Temecula menu (the wiki gives its soda bar only); the per-glass and per-drink prices at London and Backdoor SoHo; the exchange rate (about 65p to the dollar in 2015); the ownership split with Marius; every member of staff except Chaz, Marius and Andrew; the Global Occult Coalition's people and the council inspector; seats, rents, wages, sales, and every figure describing the forces; the settings' events. The save starts in May 2015, after Temecula; the wiki does not date that incident.

forces.name: MTF Lambda-14 ("One Star Reviewers")
forces.desc: The SCP Foundation's task force for retail-oriented locations and anomalies, from single restaurants to whole shopping districts. Since Temecula it has concentrated on Ambrose, filed as GoI-116: two containment teams, fifty mobile agents, ten thaumaturgy specialists and twenty anomalous art specialists, working out of Site-34 in Southern California and rarely there for long. Sergeant Gary Jannsen runs one of its field units. Specialist Rhianne Watson, the thaumaturge who got out of Temecula alone, can follow the traces a door leaves.
forces.method: Books a table and eats lunch. Then a second visit with instruments, then the shutters, a containment team in the kitchen and a thaumaturge following the traces to the back room. They approach with caution and don't fight unless someone else starts it. What they take is numbered and never comes back.
forces.price: Not money. The Foundation's kind of offer is amnesty: keep to partitioned realities, cater its facilities, and hand over Chaz.

forces.name: The Global Occult Coalition
forces.desc: The other great power that polices the anomalous, and as keen as the Foundation to see Ambrose out of business. Where the Foundation would put a cockatrice in a box, the Coalition would rather there were no cockatrice.

leader.name: Ingrid Solheim
leader.title: Assessment team lead (invented for this save)

forces.method: Watches the supply routes, not the dining rooms: the doors, the marina, the circus. When it moves, it moves on a kitchen at four in the morning and leaves nothing to reopen.
forces.price: No interest in a deal with a restaurant. Individual assessors have been known to accept a very good dinner.

forces.name: The council's environmental health team
forces.desc: Ordinary food hygiene inspectors for the borough the London restaurant is in, with a clipboard, a probe thermometer and a statutory right to see every room. They have no idea. The danger is what one of them might see on the way to the walk-in, and who reads their report afterwards.

leader.name: Priya Nandakumar
leader.title: Senior environmental health officer (invented for this save)

forces.method: Unannounced visits, a Food Hygiene Rating from 0 to 5, and a follow-up letter. She has asked twice why the staff entrance isn't on the plans.
forces.price: Can't be bought and wouldn't understand the offer. Can be shown a spotless, entirely ordinary kitchen, if the kitchen is given twenty minutes.

ops.name: The room of doors
ops.cover: A private dining room with a strict door policy, a long tasting menu and a delivery entrance that isn't on the plans. On paper it is a members' club that orders a great deal of bacon.
ops.desc: Behind each kitchen is a room of identical doors, each a Way to another kitchen, market or reality. Through them come the cockatrice, the kraken eggs and the Soul Striders, and through them go private dinners for guests who can't be seen on a London street, and crates of ingredients sold on to other kitchens behind the Veil. They pay in whatever they have: Hy-Brasil silver, sterling that was withdrawn in 1971, favours. None of it is a crime. All of it is exactly what the Foundation exists to stop the public finding out about.
leadsTo: A thaumaturge who has learned what an Ambrose door smells like
A door that opens onto somewhere it didn't yesterday

dishes.desc: Main course. Eight caviars, among them coelacanth, Salmon of Knowledge and an egg from the Kraken that attacked Hy-Brasil in 1988.
dishes.kitJ: Caviar Platter|Main course. Eight caviars, among them coelacanth, Salmon of Knowledge and an egg from the Kraken that attacked Hy-Brasil in 1988.

dishes.name: Five Senses Linguine
dishes.desc: Main course. House pesto, and a short spell of total synesthesia.
dishes.kitJ: Five Senses Linguine|Main course. House pesto, and a short spell of total synesthesia.

dishes.name: Dragon's Baked Alaska
dishes.desc: Dessert. The meringue is finished at the table by the house draconus domesticus.
dishes.kitJ: Dragon's Baked Alaska|Dessert. The meringue is finished at the table by the house draconus domesticus.

dishes.name: Volcano Cake
dishes.desc: Dessert. A chocolate lava cake that erupts once it's on the table: dark, smooth and a little spicy.
dishes.kitJ: Volcano Cake|Dessert. A chocolate lava cake that erupts once it's on the table: dark, smooth and a little spicy.

dishes.name: Fruits of the Gods
dishes.desc: Dessert. Underworld pomegranate seeds, El Doradan Golds and brandied strawberries. Ask your server what's in season.
dishes.kitJ: Fruits of the Gods|Dessert. Underworld pomegranate seeds, El Doradan Golds and brandied strawberries. Ask your server what's in season.

dishes.name: Champagne of Youth
dishes.desc: Eases the effects of age for a little while. Sharp, with ginger; best with the Caviar Platter. This product is not a youth potion.
dishes.kitJ: Champagne of Youth|Eases the effects of age for a little while. Sharp, with ginger; best with the Caviar Platter. This product is not a youth potion.

dishes.name: Thousand-Year Merlot
dishes.desc: Last year's grapes, aged in a temporal isolation vault until the wine is a little over a thousand years old.
dishes.kitJ: Thousand-Year Merlot|Last year's grapes, aged in a temporal isolation vault until the wine is a little over a thousand years old.

dishes.name: Rubedo Reserve
dishes.desc: Transmuted from human blood by forbidden alchemy: blood, dry paper and a blue-cheese finish. No humans were killed in the making.
dishes.kitJ: Rubedo Reserve|Transmuted from human blood by forbidden alchemy: blood, dry paper and a blue-cheese finish. No humans were killed in the making.

menu.identity: The London four-course prix fixe: cockatrice, an eternal stew, kraken-egg caviar and a baked Alaska finished at the table by the house dragon, at 700 GBP, or 850 with the wine selection.

team.name: Imogen Thackeray
team.bio: Chef de cuisine in London, and the person who actually runs the pass while Chaz is in meetings. She trained in ordinary kitchens and still labels everything, including the things that relabel themselves.

team.name: Vasht
team.bio: Sous chef, four arms: two on the pass and two on garnish. One of the chefs from more than eighty-seven countries, and from one place that isn't a country.

team.name: Clémence Aubert
team.bio: Pastry chef and the dragon's handler. The Baked Alaska is hers; the timing of the flame is a matter of negotiation.

team.name: Rupert Ashdown
team.bio: Keeps the wine selection and the temporal isolation vault, and explains to guests, once per table, that the Champagne of Youth is not a youth potion.

team.name: Hollis Varga
team.bio: Runs the London room and its door. Can tell within a sentence whether a guest knows what kind of restaurant this is, and has a quiet table for the ones who don't.

team.name: Dominic Reyes-Adler
team.bio: Opened Backdoor SoHo in December 2014 and chooses the sculpture for every Bloody Mary himself. Does not get on with the gallery.

team.name: Odile Marchetti
team.bio: Front of house at Backdoor SoHo and the restaurant's line to Marshall, Carter & Dark. Writes the replies to the reviews.

team.name: Bettina Kowalczyk
team.bio: Ran the line at Temecula and was off the day the Foundation came for lunch. Cooks the same menu in Three Portlands and keeps the wedges on their own shelf.

policies.name: Medical cover for all staff, whatever they are
policies.blurb: A group plan that had to be written twice: once for people and once for the rest of the payroll.

policies.name: Family meal before every service
policies.blurb: The kitchen cooks for the staff and everyone eats together before the doors open. Nothing off the guest menu.

United States.name: United States

alcohol.note: Licensed by the state; quotas in some cities.

inspections.system: County or city health department inspections; letter grades posted in some cities.

United States.mealTimes: Lunch around noon to 1pm, dinner from about 6 to 8pm.
United States.customs: Guests expect fast, attentive service, free tap water and refills, and a check brought on request. Tipping 18-22% is expected at table service.
United States.labour: At-will employment in most states; overtime after 40 hours a week; minimum wages set by state and city.

United Kingdom.name: United Kingdom

alcohol.note: Sold under a premises licence from the local council.

inspections.system: Council environmental health officers inspect unannounced and give a Food Hygiene Rating from 0 to 5, published online.

United Kingdom.mealTimes: Lunch from about 12:30 to 2pm; dinner from 7 to 9:30pm.
United Kingdom.customs: London restaurants usually add a discretionary 12.5% service charge. Prices on the menu include VAT. Guests book well ahead for anywhere talked about, and complain quietly, in writing, afterwards.
United Kingdom.labour: Employer's National Insurance on top of pay, 28 days' paid holiday a year, a national minimum wage, and written contracts.

holidays.name: Christmas party season
holidays.note: December fills with office and family dinners.

holidays.name: Valentine's Day
holidays.note: The hardest table of the year to get.

United Kingdom.source: Entered for this save. The pound's rate is an estimate for mid-2015.

Three Portlands.name: Three Portlands

alcohol.note: The soda bar chooses to be alcohol-free.

inspections.system: The city's own. No outside government's food-safety rules reach it.

Three Portlands.mealTimes: Lunch from noon; dinner from about 6pm, with students in at all hours.
Three Portlands.customs: An independent city-state in a pocket universe, in free association with the United States since 1940. People pay in dollars or sterling and nobody needs the menu explained. The FBI's Unusual Incidents Unit keeps the Foundation out under the Hoover Mandate.
Three Portlands.labour: A small city's rules, and staff who may not have papers from any country on Earth.
Three Portlands.source: From the SCP Wiki's Three Portlands page: the pocket universe, the three Ways, about 80,000 residents, dollars and sterling, free association with the United States since 1940, and the Hoover Mandate. The payroll, card and tipping figures are invented.

Backdoor SoHo.name: Backdoor SoHo
Backdoor SoHo.mealTimes: Dinner from 7pm, and the acts go on late.
Backdoor SoHo.customs: An extradimensional city behind New York's SoHo, run on art and the people who buy it. Guests come for the gallery as much as the plate, and review everything.
Backdoor SoHo.labour: Informal. Half the floor staff are artists between shows.
Backdoor SoHo.source: The wiki names Backdoor SoHo as an extradimensional city and gives the restaurant's opening event; everything else here is invented.
